description: Render the timeline to a file. Presets: web_1080p_h264 (MP4, fits 1920x1080), master_prores_422hq (MOV, sequence size), social_9x16_h264 (9:16 sequences, 1080x1920), web_1080p_av1 (MP4, AV1/Opus), gif (640 px, 15 fps), review_h264 (MP4, fits 854x854 with sound: small and quick, to watch a cut), audio_wav_48k, audio_mp3. overrides changes size, fps, bitrate or crf (video://catalog/presets). Long-running: returns a task, or {job_id} for job.get. The result links the file (a resource_link to video://jobs/{job_id}/output, which reads as the file, or its signed URL when large), has a signed download URL and a page_url that plays it in any browser (the link to give a person to watch or share), both working for 24 h (job.get gives fresh ones) . The server keeps the file 7 days: to keep it longer, save it from the url, and media.import it to use it again. qa.check measures a render (gaps, frames, loudness) before you export.
